Sales figures are approximate lifetime totals from mixed public sources — some are franchise, all-platform, or player counts (noted on the card). Within each era, games are sorted best-selling first; “—” means no reliable number. Eras follow North American release years; age labels use the birth year set on your player card (default 1983).

Your checkmarks save automatically: to cloud storage where the hosted page supports it (the indicator above shows sync state), and always to this browser as a backup. Export downloads your played list as a JSON file; the 🎮 library scan checks your whole Steam or Epic library from one paste. Coming later: play-history profiles.

Badge sprites: Kyrise's 16x16 RPG Icon Pack (CC BY 4.0), game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0), and Kenney game assets (CC0).
